notes: Self-declared grand strategy with expansion, diplomacy, economy and armies that fight automatically while the player nudges them, which is Strategy's Real-Time Strategy preset: terrain-open contested ground, buildzone-plot for province and city construction gated by territory rather than a grid, tracker-core for the capital whose capture drops production and morale, and collectible-nodes for the resource provinces. The answer says build the whole continent as one strategic map with walkable capitals, so there is a space and people do walk it — no SET — and no P4 for zone splitting; the nation-selection lobby I read as a menu rather than a built staging area, so no separate map. The prompt names mountain ranges, frozen north, plains and peninsulas plus rivers, lakes, oceans and western islands as required geography, so terrain-relief, water-body and island-cluster are picks the author actually made, and settlement-density carries the capitals and cities as built-up ground; terrain-relief is what puts tiered on the route. Two things I decided without a user: water and islands nominally flag CHECK, but nothing here is volumetric or self-occluding — ships and harbours sit on one representable surface — and the capital's government building, barracks and factory are operated through the strategy interface rather than entered, so no P3.
